title: My Father
simplified_paragraphs: 这是我的爸爸，今年55岁。他是一个老师，在四川的大学工作，星期一到星期五都要上班。他早上八点去学校，下午六点回家，吃饭以后喜欢喝茶，晚上十点睡觉。这是他的一天。
traditional_paragraphs: 這是我的爸爸，今年55歲。他是一個老師，在四川的大學工作，星期一到星期五都要上班。他早上八點去學校，下午六點回家，吃飯以後喜歡喝茶，晚上十點睡覺。這是他的一天。
pinyin_paragraphs: zhè shì wǒ de bà ba， jīn nián 55 suì。 tā shì yī gè lǎo shī， zài Sì chuān de dà xué gōng zuò， Xīng qī yī dào Xīng qī wǔ dōu yào shàng bān。 tā zǎo shang bā diǎn qù xué xiào， xià wǔ liù diǎn huí jiā， chī fàn yǐ hòu xǐ huan hē chá， wǎn shang shí diǎn shuì jiào。 zhè shì tā de yī tiān。
english_paragraphs: This is my dad. He is 55 years old. He is a teacher at a university in Sichuan and works Monday through Friday. He goes to school at eight in the morning and comes home at six in the evening. After dinner, he likes to drink tea, and he goes to bed at ten. That’s a typical day for him.
english_full: This is my dad. He is 55 years old. He is a teacher at a university in Sichuan and works Monday through Friday. He goes to school at eight in the morning and comes home at six in the evening. After dinner, he likes to drink tea, and he goes to bed at ten. That’s a typical day for him.
